name: Victims
overview: Scripture reveals that victims are those who suffer injustice and violence, yet God remains their refuge and executes righteous judgment on their behalf, as seen in Psalms 9:9 and 103:6. The sanctity of human life, created in God's image, demands accountability for shedding blood, emphasizing justice for victims (Genesis 9:6). While the righteous are tested, God hates violence and defends the oppressed (Psalms 11:5). Ultimately, Jesus is the way to restoration and true life, offering hope beyond suffering (John 14:6).
